crossRefs.note: Yahweh will cause you to be struck before your enemies. You will go out one way against them, and will flee seven ways…
You will become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword among all the peoples where Yahweh will lead you away.
Yahweh will scatter you among all peoples, from one end of the earth to the other end of the earth. There you will…
I will scatter you among the nations, and I will draw out the sword after you. Your land will be a desolation, and your…
You will perish among the nations. The land of your enemies will eat you up.
For you are our Father, though Abraham doesn’t know us, and Israel does not acknowledge us. You, Yahweh, are our…
They will fall by the edge of the sword, and will be led captive into all the nations. Jerusalem will be trampled down…

translations.web: I said that I would scatter them afar. I would make their memory to cease from among men;
translations.bsb: I would have said that I would cut them to pieces and blot out their memory from mankind,
translations.kjv: I said, I would scatter them into corners, I would make the remembrance of them to cease from among men:
